proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 52 prints /gali/ “scolding, abuse,” contrasting aspirated /gʰali/ “pour.ABS.” Turner4145 gives Nepali gāli “abuse,” Oriya gāḷī “scolding,” and Maithili gārī; the unaspirated Darai word matches this family.

proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 53 prints /bapʰaike/ “to cook by boiling.” Turner9225 gives Sindhi bāphaṇu “to cook by steam” and Gujarati bāphvũ “to boil”; Darai bapʰ- shares the steam-cooking verb, with -aike as local verbal morphology.
